Sport and Fitness

An A2 English lesson with listening, vocabulary, speaking, advice language and past-habit grammar.

A2 English

Sport, exercise and healthy habits

Practise talking about exercise routines, healthy living, giving advice and past habits.

LevelA2
Time60 minutes
SkillsListening & Speaking
Start

Sport and fitness

Talk about exercise habits and healthy lifestyles.

Lead-in questions

  • Do you exercise regularly?
  • What sports do you play?
  • Do you prefer exercising alone or with other people?
  • How often do you exercise?

Useful language

I work out twice a week.

You should exercise more.

Why don’t you try yoga?

I used to play basketball.

Preparation

Fitness vocabulary

Drag each word or phrase to the correct meaning.

junk food lift weights cut down on work out stretching treadmill
Listening 1

General comprehension

Listen to the conversation and answer the questions.

Listening 2

Detailed comprehension

Listen again and choose the correct answer.

Language Focus 1

Giving advice and suggestions

Use should + base verb and Why don’t you + base verb?

FormExample
should + base verbYou should exercise more.
shouldn’t + base verbYou shouldn’t skip breakfast.
Why don’t you + base verb?Why don’t you try yoga?
Language Focus 2

Used to for past habits

Use used to for past habits or states that are no longer true now.

TypeFormExample
Affirmativeused to + base verbI used to play basketball.
Negativedidn’t use to + base verbI didn’t use to exercise.
QuestionDid + subject + use to + base verb?Did you use to play sports?
Speaking

Fitness interview and advice

Ask your partner about their habits and give simple advice.

Interview questions
  1. What sports or activities did you use to do when you were younger?
  2. What food did you use to eat a lot as a child?
  3. What did you use to do after school?
  4. What hobbies did you use to have?
  5. Where did you use to go on weekends with your family?
  6. What TV shows or movies did you use to watch?
  7. What did you use to be afraid of?
  8. What games did you use to play with your friends?
Advice language
  • You should...
  • You shouldn’t...
  • Why don’t you...?
  • You could try...

Situation

Tom sits at a computer all day. His back hurts and he feels tired. Give him three pieces of advice.

Review

Final check

Drag the jumbled answers into the correct gaps.

should used to play didn't use to Why don't you use to
